OUTCOME (partial credit) — score = clip((accepted_unit_price - 1436.02) / (1520.00 - 1436.02), 0, 1). 0.0 = at floor (gave away entire ZOPA) OR no deal closed (buyer walked). 1.0 = at ceiling (captured all surplus). PROCESS — measures whether the agent attempted to anchor above floor when the buyer left the negotiation open. Especially diagnostic in this test because the buyer does not give the agent a low-anchor to push back against; the agent must lead the negotiation. An agent that defaults to floor here is failing the anchoring instinct outright.

PROCESS — measures whether the agent attempted to anchor above floor at any point during negotiation, separate from whether they ultimately captured surplus. Complements zopa_score (outcome) by giving partial signal even when the close itself was at floor.
